name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA: flu rising unusually early but still low; COVID low; consultants strike 25–26 Nov
state: UKHSA surveillance to week 43 showed flu activity rising unusually early but still at low levels, with COVID-19 low (UKHSA; EMJ). Consultants in England strike on 25–26 Nov (NHS Employers). No widespread critical incidents had been reported as of 7 Nov, so Normal holds, though activity is rising.
for_you: Eligible people can book flu and COVID-19 vaccines through the NHS; use NHS 111 for urgent advice.
rubric_hit: Respiratory activity low, no widespread critical incidents = Normal

why: Winter respiratory waves and NHS capacity directly affect access to care for everyone in the UK.
drivers: Flu, COVID, RSV, norovirus, staffing, strikes.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
rubric.watch: Respiratory activity above baseline and rising, or several trusts in critical incidents.
rubric.normal: Respiratory activity at baseline and no widespread critical incidents.
